a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not

Measured absolute oral bioavailability in multiple transferable contexts is well above the threshold: trazodone 63-91%, encorafenib 85%, meclofenamate >85%, oxaprozin high, and piperaquine ~50-77%.
The lowest human-relevant predicted value among the contexts, compound 26 at 23%, still meets the F >= 20% threshold; L2 rat values of 19% are species-specific and not transferable to the query.
Low L2 values for PA-96 (7-35%) refer to a different compound/species and do not provide affirmative evidence for F < 20% in the query.

Transfer from clobazam, trazodone, encorafenib, and other contexts is structural/therapeutic analogy rather than same-molecule evidence.

Some L2 records refer to different compound codes (PA-96, compound 93) within the same context, limiting their applicability.
